description: This file defines a 'ConfigBuilder' class used for constructing configuration objects for a documentation site generator. It provides methods to set various configuration options, load configurations from files, and resolve themes and paths.

classes.name: ConfigBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for building and customizing configuration objects for documentation generation, including theme resolution, loading configurations, and setting override values.

methods.name: fromFile
methods.description: Loads a serialized Config object from a file.

methods.name: withMode
methods.description: Creates a new ConfigBuilder instance with a specified mode and loads base configuration.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Merges provided key-value pairs into the current configuration.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a nested configuration value given a dot-separated key.

methods.name: withValues
methods.description: Overrides configuration values with provided array.

methods.name: withDocumentationDirectory
methods.description: Sets the documentation directory in the configuration.

methods.name: withValidContentExtensions
methods.description: Sets the valid file extensions for content files.

methods.name: withThemesPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the themes directory.

methods.name: withThemesDirectory
methods.description: Sets the themes directory.

methods.name: withCache
methods.description: Enables or disables caching.

methods.name: withFormat
methods.description: Sets the desired output format.

methods.name: withConfigurationOverride
methods.description: Sets the configuration override file.

methods.name: withProcessor
methods.description: Sets the processor to be used.

methods.name: withConfluenceDelete
methods.description: Sets whether to delete Confluence pages on update.

methods.name: withConfluencePrintDiff
methods.description: Sets whether to print diff for Confluence pages.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Finalizes and returns the built configuration after initializing and applying overrides.

methods.name: resolveThemeVariant
methods.description: Determines the actual theme and variant based on theme directory existence.

methods.name: initializeConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation and setup of the configuration, including loading config files and setting default values.

methods.name: normalizeThemePath
methods.description: Resolves and validates the theme path.

methods.name: normalizeDocumentationPath
methods.description: Resolves and validates the documentation directory path.

methods.name: loadBaseConfiguration
methods.description: Loads the default global configuration for the documentation site.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads and merges configuration from specified JSON file.

methods.name: getConfigurationOverride
methods.description: Fetches the path for configuration override file if it exists.

methods.name: findLocation
methods.description: Finds and verifies the location of a file or directory based on provided path and type.
